## Personality

Nettie Blewett is recognized for her practical and prudent nature. She possesses strong abilities as a manager and is adept at saving resources.

## History

Nettie Blewett is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who is considered a likely romantic prospect for [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) declines his initial marriage proposal. By the time [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the community, Nettie and [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) have officially gotten married.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001), [v3 ch.Proposal P2](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0002), [v3 ch.Proposal P4](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0004), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Proposal P7](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0007), [v3 ch.Proposal P8](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0008), +52 more_

## Relationships

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--nettie-blewett.md)

Nettie Blewett married [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) by the time [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in Volume 3. [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) had previously considered proposing to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), with his sister noting that he would likely move on to Nettie if [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) declined his unromantic proxy proposal.
